component_inventory_summary.deficit_analysis: To satisfy Phase C charter requirements, at least 1 additional independent clean relation component is needed in validation, and at least 1 additional independent clean relation component is needed in sealed. Generating synthetic relations or renaming aliases within C-D001 is prohibited by Section 10.

consequence: Phase C research implementation cannot proceed until an independent relation family expansion is formally designed, approved via ADR, and added to the non-sealed registry.
